Beach access is just a few steps away for beachcombing, kite flying, or viewing beautiful sunsets. Nearby Ocean Shores is proclaimed the razor clam capital of the world for the clam digger or you can try your luck at the casino! blurb: Lake Sawyer boasts a year-’round resort in the greater Seattle area. The resort’s spacious ten-acre grounds with tall firs and park-like lawns make it a popular spot for picnics. Lake Sawyer is one of the area’s largest natural lakes containing some of the best bass fishing in the state.
